states.idle: Entrance open; east seal closed; boss idle; no encounter damage.
states.dialogue: Gate closed; east seal closed; all damage paused; play boss_intro.
states.combat: Both barriers closed; boss theme and capped summon scheduling active.
states.defeat: Stop every damage source; disintegration and slow whiteout; remove all threats.
states.cleared: Both barriers open; boss/summons/hazards/projectiles absent; pending reward may remain.

boss.entry_rule: Continuously test occupied throat while idle; after full mask clears north of row29 top (pixel y1856), pause damage, walk to [122,26], close gate, frame dialogue. Intro-seen never suppresses encounter initialization after failure.
boss.thunder_rule: Initial warning >=1.0 s; committed targets never move. Preserve a connected unmarked strip >=3 cells wide reachable at actual move speed; no offscreen damage or complete coverage.
boss.summon_rule: Attempt capped bats per complete cycle. Use authored points >=3 cells from Dave and safe strip; postpone if no legal point.
boss.camera_rule: Keep 1280x720. Frame both actors for intro, blend to follow before combat; attacking actors and warnings must be visible. No laser/thunder combination may close every escape.

music_by_state.defeat: stop loop, then resolution after whiteout

boss.health_tuning: 3-5 minute initial target with main-route equipment; optional sword/armor and grinding not assumed.
